errors.quote: keeping the dimension lost on decreasing edges small relative to the number $N$ of data roles
errors.problem: N is the number of indices a∈T^3, i.e. the number of roles X_a. There are 2N data roles (X_a and Y_a). The page's own later definition ('$N=\binom h3^3$ counts the roles $X_a$') is correct.

errors.quote: Subspace labels give each network vertex a subspace, so an edge costs its label dimension change.
errors.problem: An edge's cost equals its label dimension change only when its labels are nested and nondegenerate. In the bit network, the N first edges of X_a cost rank one with zero dimension change (paper: 'The only exceptions are the $N$ negative source projections'). The page notes this exception later.

errors.quote: $X$ labels grow from $A\otimes\langle t\rangle$ to $A\otimes F$, $Y$ labels from $B\otimes\langle t\rangle$ to $(P\otimes\langle t\rangle)^\perp_{A\otimes F}$
errors.problem: The tensor factor Q=⟨t_{a_{j+1}}⊗…⊗t_{a_3}⟩ is omitted without comment. The paper's labels are A⊗⟨t⟩⊗Q, etc., which are subspaces of the full tensor space. Without Q they lie in F^{⊗j}, and 'outgoing labels equal next incoming labels' needs Q=⟨t_{a_{j+1}}⟩⊗Q'.

errors.quote: $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere
errors.problem: The paper has 'zero on its orthogonal complement' (of V∩U^⊥). P_U is the projection along U^⊥, which the page never says. 'Elsewhere' is not a subspace.

errors.quote: A residual has an orthonormal basis $\mathcal B$ (it has a norm-one coordinate vector)
errors.problem: Some residuals contain no coordinate unit vector. For example, the side residual P⊗⟨t_Y⟩⊗Q is a line spanned by a weight-27 vector. In the paper, the norm-one vector is a tensor of coordinate units with the norm-one vectors of P, Q and the triple lines. A norm-one vector only makes a nondegenerate residual nonalternating; the orthonormal basis then comes from the paper's splitting argument, and only for nonzero residuals.

errors.quote: Using $C=iZC^{-1}Z$ on $X_a\to Y_a$, every role receives $C^{\otimes m}$.
errors.problem: The paper needs explicit corrections: Z_{a,k} before the network at X_a and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after it at Y_a, which turn the 27 inverse factors on supp(u_a) into C. The route Y_a→X_a carries the scalar sign -1, so the physical X outputs must be negated and output role rho(w) sent back to w. Z is undefined on the page.
